content: Continue M0110/W0112 solely from the current canonical repository files under the D0029 governance epoch after SC0007. Own the dependency-valid Local cdev Vertical Slice Exit Gate: connect the daemon lease and object table to live registered-memory handles, prove unmodified Add/Copy through /dev/metafluxN with replacement-generation isolation, and execute Linux 6.12/6.18 kernel fault qualification. Do not load a liquidated session ledger as task context or reconstruct a pre-SC0007 workflow.

Revision 0bba77f87c8f0737513a6873eb8325af54ff4852 implements persistent full-range CPU backend handles for embedded daemon object-table memory, explicit operation retain/release accounting, retirement draining, and daemon teardown reclamation. The daemon cdev backend build passed; focused cdev/daemon CTest passed 6/6; full development CTest passed 85/85. Live /dev/metafluxN lease/import, replacement-generation isolation, and Linux 6.12/6.18 kernel fault qualification remain open under W0112.

Revision fcfaa8d is the current W0112 worker/kernel payload-mapping slice: CdevWorkerSession::open_current negotiates the current view and generation on the same control fd before leasing, map_payload maps the exact page-aligned data-owner arena through the lease, and close/move preserve VMA and lease lifetime ordering. The kernel permits a worker lease fd to map the online payload while retaining data-fd ownership. Development CTest passed 85/85 and Linux 6.18 Kbuild passed; /dev/metafluxctl and /dev/metaflux0 are absent, so live daemon attachment, generation replacement, and fault qualification remain open.

Revision 5050915992771444398879212e37529b44b704ce adds MF_UAPI_IOCTL_MEMORY_QUERY using the existing fixed memory record. A negotiated worker lease queries the online data-owner payload's generation, exact page-aligned size, and mmap offset; CdevWorkerSession::map_current_payload consumes that response and the kernel rechecks owner and length under the cdev lock. Schema validation, lifecycle model checks, full development CTest 85/85, and Linux 6.18 Kbuild passed. Live device-node attach, daemon object-table wiring, generation replacement, and fault qualification remain open.

The post-query manifest-closure repair is recorded at content revision 5050915992771444398879212e37529b44b704ce and checkpoint revision cd8d06d. The base and lifecycle extension hashes now agree; full development CTest passed 85/85 after the repair, including lifecycle model checks. The D0029 W0112 focus remains active with daemon-side live cdev lease/import and kernel fault qualification open.

Revision c9682ff serializes MF_UAPI_IOCTL_MEMORY_QUERY lease and negotiation checks with mf_cdev_release under mf_cdev_lock. Development CTest passed 85/85, Linux 6.18 Kbuild passed with the existing compiler-version warning, and agent records passed. This closes the query-path concurrency refinement; live daemon cdev attachment, generation replacement, and kernel fault qualification remain open.

Revision 780222c serializes mutable per-file negotiation, lease, queue, and registered-memory authorization checks in cdev ioctl, mmap, and poll paths under mf_cdev_lock, matching mf_cdev_release and preserving errno/resource-unwind behavior. Linux 6.18 Kbuild passed, full development CTest passed 85/85, and agent records passed before this record update. Live daemon cdev attachment, generation replacement, and Linux 6.12/6.18 fault qualification remain open.

The live cdev product seam is explicit: Session::serve starts only the Unix-ring EmbeddedCpuWorker; standalone cdev region descriptors require a daemon object table that the cdev client does not create or bind; and the CPU backend import helper consumes host virtual ranges rather than kernel registered-memory handles. The open M0110 decision on provider cdev selection and M0100 fallback diagnostics is a hard gate before provider wiring. Next boundary: resolve that selection/fallback and import contract, then connect live cdev Add/Copy.
